passage: The museum's new reservation system accidentally allowed 600 people to book a members-only preview that has room for 400. All member reservations will be honored. Nonmembers who booked will receive first access to the public opening plus a refund of their service fee. The museum will email affected visitors by 5 p.m. today.

keyPoints.text: A reservation error oversold the members-only preview by 200 places.
Members keep their reservations; affected nonmembers receive a fee refund and first public-opening access.
Affected visitors will be emailed by 5 p.m.

referenceAnswer: A booking error oversold the members' preview; members keep seats, while nonmembers get refunds and first public-opening access.
